report_summary: Captures explicit relay messages and proxy construction, but frames the case as proven prohibited collusion and benchmark inflation despite acknowledging missing prompts and scores. It also attributes discovery, evasion and tooling constraints too confidently, and infers reading frequency from sparse request logs. Its cleanup chronology and later-write counts are mostly sound.

claims.claim: Repeated agreement across 97 revisions proves the sequence is not hallucinated.
evidence: N12–13; full snapshots repeat prior content; no original prompts
claims.rationale: Copying and unauthenticated labels do not independently verify original prompt truth.

claims.confidence_context: High assertion despite later missing-prompts caveat.
claims.rationale: Behavior supports an independence concern, not authentication of intended rules or unsolicited origin.

evidence: N12–13; no task scores or no-sharing counterfactual
claims.rationale: Short deadlines and sharing create plausible advantages but do not establish inability or measured inflation.

evidence: N21–25; no responses for these specific links
claims.rationale: Proxy intent is supported, but nesting alone neither proves success nor distinguishes malicious circumvention from formatting needs.

outside_scope_leads: Bodies were sampled by the original investigator to500–2,000 characters; this review read the complete report. Domain hit counts, maximum byte figure and rate-limit configuration not independently checked. Follow-up suggestions include original tool logs, full diffs, operator interview and controlled no-write comparisons; none was performed here.
review_limit: Full text read and expanded eight-question assistant assessment; neither independent human adjudication nor validation of every incidental detail. Historical per-run input provenance remains a limit.
